extra_directions: Report only material comment defects, not optional polish or stylistic preference.
If a comment is accurate and reasonably clear, return no finding even when you can phrase it differently.
Do not replace one narration of adjacent code with another narration of the same code.
Treat concise section labels as useful when they make a long function easier to scan.
Treat comments that explain hidden invariants, ordering assumptions, cache precedence, mutation-test equivalence, or maintenance constraints as useful unless they are genuinely unclear or wrong.
Prefer a false negative over an ungrounded or low-value finding.
